001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.rolling;
002
003import java.io.File;
004import java.net.URI;
005import java.nio.file.Path;
006import java.util.function.Consumer;
007import java.util.function.Supplier;
008
009import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
010
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogMetrics;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider;
015import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProviderRef;
016import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable;
017import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable.ConvertParameter;
018import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable.DefaultParameter;
019import io.jstach.rainbowgum.file.DataSize;
020import io.jstach.rainbowgum.file.FileOutput;
021import io.jstach.rainbowgum.file.FileOutputBuilder;
022
023/**
024 * A {@link FileOutput} that rolls (renames the active file to a numbered archive and
025 * starts a fresh one) once it grows past {@code maxFileSize}, retaining at most
026 * {@code maxHistory} archives.
027 * <p>
028 * Deliberately size (not calendar/date) triggered and only supports a <code>%i</code>
029 * (rotation index) token in {@link #DEFAULT_FILE_NAME_PATTERN} - see
030 * {@code doc/overview.html}'s "Rolling Files" section for why: reopen-on-external-signal
031 * (e.g. via <code>logrotate</code>) remains the recommended approach for anything beyond
032 * "keep a small/desktop app from filling its disk", and that simpler need does not
033 * benefit from Logback-style calendar based archive naming.
034 * <p>
035 * Registered under the {@value #ROLLING_SCHEME} URI scheme (see
036 * {@code RollingConfigurator}), e.g. {@code rolling:///var/log/app.log?maxFileSize=...}.
037 * Its properties are <code>logging.appender.{name}.output.rolling.</code> followed by a
038 * {@link RollingFileOutputBuilder} property name. {@code fileName}, {@code append},
039 * {@code prudent} and {@code bufferSize} mean the same as for {@link FileOutput} and are
040 * passed to the underlying file output this wraps. The {@code append} setting applies
041 * when the output is first opened. Replacement outputs always append so recovery
042 * preserves any active contents left behind by a failed rotation.
043 * <p>
044 * Failed automatic rotation attempts record {@link LogMetrics#ROLL_FAIL_METRIC} and an
045 * error alert identifying the active file. The event that triggered the failed rotation
046 * is not retried and also counts toward {@link LogMetrics#EVENTS_FAILED_METRIC}. The next
047 * write attempts to recover the output. Archive changes already completed before a
048 * failure are not rolled back. An explicit {@link #reopen()} after external rotation
049 * instead uses {@link LogMetrics#REOPEN_FAIL_METRIC}.
050 * <p>
051 * Only one process should rotate these files. Prudent mode locks individual writes, but
052 * does not coordinate archive rotation between processes.
053 */
054public interface RollingFileOutput extends FileOutput {
055
056        /**
057         * URI scheme for rolling file outputs.
058         */
059        static final String ROLLING_SCHEME = "rolling";
060
061        /**
062         * Default buffer size, the same as {@link FileOutput#DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE}.
063         */
064        static final DataSize DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE = FileOutput.DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE;
065
066        /**
067         * Default max file size before a roll is triggered: 10MB, matching Logback and Spring
068         * Boot's own default.
069         */
070        static final DataSize DEFAULT_MAX_FILE_SIZE = DataSize.ofMegabytes(10);
071
072        /**
073         * Default number of archives to retain - 7, matching Logback/Spring Boot's own
074         * default.
075         */
076        static final int DEFAULT_MAX_HISTORY = 7;
077
078        /**
079         * Default total archive size cap. {@link DataSize#ZERO} means unlimited.
080         */
081        static final DataSize DEFAULT_TOTAL_SIZE_CAP = DataSize.ZERO;
082
083        /**
084         * Default for whether archive pruning ({@code maxHistory}/{@code totalSizeCap}) also
085         * runs once at {@link #start(LogConfig)}, not just after each roll.
086         */
087        static final boolean DEFAULT_CLEAN_HISTORY_ON_START = false;
088
089        /**
090         * Default {@code fileNamePattern} - the literal text appended directly after the
091         * active file's own path (unlike Logback, never containing the base file name itself)
092         * with <code>%i</code> substituted for the rotation index, e.g. <code>app.log</code>
093         * with this pattern archives to <code>app.log.1</code>, <code>app.log.2</code>, etc.
094         * A pattern ending in <code>.gz</code> gzip compresses archives on rotation.
095         */
096        static final String DEFAULT_FILE_NAME_PATTERN = ".%i";
097
098        /**
099         * Creates a rolling file output provider from a URI reference - the entry point used
100         * by the {@value #ROLLING_SCHEME} scheme registration.
101         * @param ref uri reference, may have a query string of builder properties (same
102         * convention as {@link FileOutput#of(LogProviderRef)}).
103         * @return provider.
104         */
105        public static LogProvider<io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogOutput> of(LogProviderRef ref) {
106                return (name, config) -> provide(ref, name, config);
107        }
108
109        /**
110         * Creates a rolling file output provider from a lambda builder and uses the config
111         * properties from the returned log provider - mirrors
112         * {@link FileOutput#of(Consumer)}.
113         * @param consumer builder lambda.
114         * @return provider.
115         */
116        public static LogProvider<RollingFileOutput> of(Consumer<RollingFileOutputBuilder> consumer) {
117                return (name, config) -> {
118                        var builder = new RollingFileOutputBuilder(name);
119                        consumer.accept(builder);
120                        builder.fromProperties(config.properties());
121                        return builder.build().provide(name, config);
122                };
123        }
124
125        private static FileOutput provide(LogProviderRef ref, String name, LogConfig config) {
126                var b = new RollingFileOutputBuilder(name);
127                var uri = ref.uri();
128                var properties = config.properties();
129                LogProperties combined;
130                if (uri.getQuery() != null) {
131                        combined = LogProperties.of(uri, b.propertyPrefix(), properties, ref.keyOrNull());
132                        String s = uri.toString();
133                        int index = s.indexOf('?');
134                        uri = URI.create(s.substring(0, index));
135                }
136                else {
137                        combined = properties;
138                }
139                b.uri(uri);
140                b.fromProperties(combined);
141                return b.build().provide(name, config);
142        }
143
144        /**
145         * Creates a rolling file output provider.
146         * @param name name of output, not file name.
147         * @param uri file uri, set by the appender from its <code>output.uri</code>.
148         * @param fileName file name.
149         * @param append whether or not to append to an existing file when first opened.
150         * @param prudent logback prudent mode where files are locked on each write.
151         * @param bufferSize buffer size, in
152         * {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.file.DataSize#parse(String)} format when set by
153         * property, e.g. {@code 8KB}. Zero means unbuffered.
154         * @param maxFileSize max file size before a roll is triggered, in
155         * {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.file.DataSize#parse(String)} format when set by
156         * property, e.g. {@code 10MB}.
157         * @param maxHistory number of archives to retain.
158         * @param totalSizeCap total archive size cap; zero means unlimited.
159         * @param cleanHistoryOnStart whether pruning also runs once at start, not just after
160         * each roll.
161         * @param fileNamePattern archive naming pattern; must contain <code>%i</code> and
162         * must not contain <code>%d</code> (date based rotation is not supported).
163         * @return rolling file output provider.
164         */
165        @LogConfigurable(name = "RollingFileOutputBuilder", prefix = LogProperties.OUTPUT_PREFIX + "rolling.")
166        public static LogProvider<RollingFileOutput> of(@LogConfigurable.KeyParameter String name,
167                        @LogConfigurable.PassThroughParameter @Nullable URI uri, @Nullable String fileName,
168                        @Nullable Boolean append, @Nullable Boolean prudent,
169                        @ConvertParameter("parseDataSize") @DefaultParameter("DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE") DataSize bufferSize,
170                        @ConvertParameter("parseDataSize") @DefaultParameter("DEFAULT_MAX_FILE_SIZE") DataSize maxFileSize,
171                        @DefaultParameter("DEFAULT_MAX_HISTORY") Integer maxHistory,
172                        @ConvertParameter("parseDataSize") @DefaultParameter("DEFAULT_TOTAL_SIZE_CAP") DataSize totalSizeCap,
173                        @DefaultParameter("DEFAULT_CLEAN_HISTORY_ON_START") Boolean cleanHistoryOnStart,
174                        @DefaultParameter("DEFAULT_FILE_NAME_PATTERN") String fileNamePattern) {
175                var parsedPattern = RollingPolicy.ParsedPattern.parse(fileNamePattern);
176                File file;
177                if (fileName != null) {
178                        file = new File(fileName);
179                }
180                else if (uri != null) {
181                        file = new File(uri.getPath());
182                }
183                else {
184                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("fileName and uri cannot both be unset.");
185                }
186                Path activeFile = file.toPath().toAbsolutePath();
187                String fileNameForDelegate = file.getPath();
188                long maxFileSize_ = maxFileSize.toBytes();
189                int maxHistory_ = maxHistory;
190                long totalSizeCap_ = totalSizeCap.toBytes();
191                boolean cleanHistoryOnStart_ = cleanHistoryOnStart;
192                return (n, config) -> {
193                        var fileBuilder = new FileOutputBuilder(n).fileName(fileNameForDelegate)
194                                .append(append == null ? true : append)
195                                .prudent(prudent)
196                                .bufferSize(bufferSize);
197                        var initialOutput = fileBuilder.build().provide(n, config);
198                        // append=false applies only to initial opening. Recovery must preserve any
199                        // active contents left behind by a failed rotation.
200                        var replacementProvider = fileBuilder.append(true).build();
201                        Supplier<FileOutput> supplier = () -> replacementProvider.provide(n, config);
202                        return new DefaultRollingFileOutput(activeFile, parsedPattern, maxFileSize_, maxHistory_, totalSizeCap_,
203                                        cleanHistoryOnStart_, supplier, initialOutput, config);
204                };
205        }
206
207        /**
208         * Converts a {@code maxFileSize} or {@code totalSizeCap} property value.
209         * @param value property value.
210         * @return data size.
211         * @see DataSize#parse(String)
212         */
213        static DataSize parseDataSize(String value) {
214                return DataSize.parse(value);
215        }
216
217}
